all_sources.title: Google Deepmind 在推出 Argon 僅兩週後即發布了 Gemini 4 Carbon，各項指標均有所提升 / Google Deepmind releases Gemini 4 Carbon just two weeks after Argon with gains across the board
all_sources.title_zh: Google Deepmind 在推出 Argon 僅兩週後即發布了 Gemini 4 Carbon，各項指標均有所提升
all_sources.title_en: Google Deepmind releases Gemini 4 Carbon just two weeks after Argon with gains across the board
all_sources.title_original: Google Deepmind releases Gemini 4 Carbon just two weeks after Argon with gains across the board
all_sources.summary: Just two weeks after Gemini 4 Argon, Google DeepMind is releasing Gemini 4 Carbon, which tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 with 59 points. Google says the model is built for extended agent workflows and the full cyber defense lifecycle. Because of those advanced security capabilities, access is limited to selected security experts at first. The article Google Deepmind releases Gemini 4 Carbon just two weeks after Argon with gains across the board appeared first on The Decoder .
all_sources.summary_zh: 在推出 Gemini 4 Argon 僅兩週後，Google DeepMind 即推出了 Gemini 4 Carbon，該模型在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 中以 59 分名列榜首。Google 表示，該模型專為長時間運行的代理工作流程以及完整的網路防禦生命週期而建構。由於這些先進的安全功能，存取權限最初僅限於選定的網路安全專家。本文 Google Deepmind releases Gemini 4 Carbon just two weeks after Argon with gains across the board 首次發表於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: Microsoft said it made $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter ending September 30. It underscores the still-enormous financial dependency of the partnership.
sources.summary_zh: 微軟 表示，在截至 9 月 30 日的季度中，其透過與 OpenAI 的商業安排（包括收益分成付款）獲得了 10 億美元的收入。這凸顯了雙方合作關係中依然巨大的財務依賴性。

sources.summary: OpenMOSS等團隊發佈開源圖像生成模型MOSS-Image，針對海報、信息圖、漫畫及UI設計中文字拼寫錯誤、段落截斷、元素錯位等痛點，採用5B參數單流DiT基座從零預訓練，支持最長約4K token提示詞、中英文長文本渲染及可編輯結構化JSON Layout，旨在提升複雜圖文排版生成質量。
